name: Labor Insurance (勞工保險)
authority: Labor Insurance Act articles 6, 8, 9, 13–15; Enforcement Rules articles 27, 28-1 and 33. Ordinary-risk premium rate 11.5%, shared 20% employee, 70% employer and 10% government. Registered continuing cover remains chargeable after age 65. Apply the declared insured salary grade and covered days on a thirty-day calendar; round each share once after day proration. Variable wages use an independently recorded three-month-average declaration. Salary changes do not automatically change the insured grade; notified adjustments take effect on the first of the following month. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0007758.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0014162.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006928.html

elections.description: Enter the insurer-confirmed monthly grade. The registration dates are its effective dates, not the salary-change or notification dates.

name: 積欠工資墊償基金 (wage arrears payment fund)
authority: Labor Standards Act article 28. Sum all covered workers’ prorated LI-equivalent insured salaries, including workers covered only by employment or occupational accident insurance, then apply 0.025% and round once to the nearest whole dollar at company level. Source: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0110180.html

name: Employment Insurance (就業保險)
authority: Employment Insurance Act articles 5, 8 and 40; Labor Insurance Act article 15; Enforcement Rules article 28-1. The 1% premium is shared 20% employee, 70% employer and 10% government. Coverage uses the statutory age and nationality/registration conditions. Apply the independently declared insured grade and covered days on a thirty-day calendar, rounding each share once after proration. Notified grade adjustments take effect on the first of the following month. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0014162.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006928.html

name: National Health Insurance (全民健康保險)
authority: National Health Insurance Act articles 18, 27, 29 and 30; Enforcement Rules article 52. Regular premiums use the declared insured amount at the month-end insuring unit. name: National Health Insurance (全民健康保險)
authority: National Health Insurance Act articles 18, 27, 29 and 30; Enforcement Rules article 52. Regular premiums use the declared insured amount at the month-end insuring unit. The employee pays 30% of the 5.17% premium for self and up to three enrolled dependants; published whole-dollar per-person premiums apply. The employer pays 60% with the published 1.56 average dependant factor. The declaration is independent of contract salary and retains its effective dates. Sources: https://www.nhi.gov.tw/en/cp-68-8652 f-35-2.html ; https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/cp-4516-74 b 0 f-2613-1.html

name: Resident income tax withholding (薪資所得扣繳)
authority: 所得稅法 article 88; 各類所得扣繳率標準 article 2; 薪資所得扣繳辦法 articles 6–7. Resident regular salary is assessed on the full month's payments, separately from non-monthly bonus payments. The table method requires a dated declaration reference and the declared spouse/dependant count. Family records do not grant table exemptions. Without the declaration, article 6 requires 5%; an explicit 5% election also uses that method. The 5% method truncates tax to whole NT dollars before applying the NT$2,000 exemption; NT$40,020 is the first whole-dollar salary requiring withholding. The table method uses the 115年度 table (台財稅字第11404675280號函): NT$101,000 personal exemption, NT$272,000 married standard deduction and NT$227,000 salary deduction. Published salary bands truncate table tax to NT$10; salaries above NT$500,000 or more than eleven spouse/dependant exemptions use the annualised formula in explanation (3), truncated to NT$1. Current-month voluntary labour pension contributions are excluded once under 勞工退休金條例 article 14(4). Tax fractions below NT$1 are discarded under 各級公庫代理銀行代辦機構及代收稅款機構稅款解繳作業辦法 article 5 (https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL051526). Tax residency must be declared on dated employment terms; citizenship does not determine residence. https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw/etwmain/tax-info/understanding/tax-q-and-a/national/individual-income-tax/withheld-rule/rule/NM11BZY

name: Wage arrears fund — covered wages
authority: Labor Standards Act article 28 and BLI wage arrears fund calculation guidance. Covered wages use each worker’s LI-equivalent insured salary, prorated for covered days on a thirty-day calendar. Workers covered only by employment or occupational accident insurance remain included. This assessment records the wage basis; the company fund scheme calculates and rounds the levy once. Source: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0110180.html Insured amounts must be declared separately from contractual wages; changing contract pay does not change the registered grade. Insurance declarations use the insurer-confirmed effective interval. BLI notices generally take effect on the first day of the following month. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006928.html
